name: generated-visual-assets
description: Produce a coherent series of AI-generated illustrations for a product, reproducibly.

interface.shortDescription: Generate a consistent series of product illustrations.
interface.longDescription: Generated Visual Assets covers the method for producing a coherent series of AI-generated illustrations: a layered prompt that keeps a whole catalogue on one press, versioned runs that make a result traceable to its prompt, and a crop contract that serves hero, thumbnail and banner from a single source.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Generated Visual Assets to set up a reproducible illustration series for this product.
